content: Yɛsu kusà a Pilatu
Ututu tutu, andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ bàköŋ ntɔn mutsüül Yɛsu mbar a ukwà.
Ba bun'bäm in'siŋ, bun'twääl, waa bun'pɛ akà kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r Pilatu.
Nkweel a Yudasi
Apan, Yudasi mbuur kun'yälà, umpal kàwem nde naa Yɛsu bàmutsüül mbar a ukwà, nde kàfuur an'kyän, waa kàyàfuur itɛr a ngim an'kwem an'tär akà andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ.
Waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ, mɛ kàkyer ube muyälà an'kil ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ube! » Wɛɛ ba bun'fuur naa: « Kwo akà bi nkye? Nsaŋ angye ŋakwo! »
Yudasi kàwɔm itɛr a ngim bya uboo a ndwà a Nzam, laa kàtoo nde, waa kàkàbäm un'siŋ.
Andweer a angaŋ bàwɛl ngim ayi, waa bàtɛn naa: « Ikwe tɛy musà ngim ayi uboo a un'naaŋ a ndwà a Nzam, ntɔn ya yà ngim a an'kil. »
Ungö bàköŋ ba, ba bàsöm ywaŋ akà un'boom a mpfwee ntɔn mudye angyey.
Undiir awun, bàfàbel ba ywaŋ alà naa "ywaŋ a an'kil" tii ŋàbawà.
Apan, ndaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Yɛlɛmya waa yàkwe: « Ba bàwɛl itɛr an'kwem an'tär byà ngim, ntal bàtsül baan a Isàlɛl mukun'som,
waa ba bàpɛ ya ntɔn ywaŋ a un'boom a mpfwee asànaa kàswɛŋ Mwol abun. »
Yɛsu kusà a Pilatu
Yɛsu kàkäl kusà a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r. Kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kun'fuul naa: « Nkye ngye awà mfum a Ayuda? » Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ngye ŋakwo an'tɛn. »
Wɛɛ utaaŋ bun'füünà andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ, nde akà ndaa mwɛy kàfuur anki.
Apan Pilatu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Nkye ngye aweemà anki ndaa yanswà bafüünà ba yi? »
Nde kun'fuur anki akà undiir mwɛy. Abà, kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kàbem mbɔɔn.
Yɛsu bàmutsüül mbar a ukwà
Yàmɛnà naa kà un'kyɔm wanswà, kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kàkäl anà nkääl mutsuuŋ mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy ntɔn un'sɛŋ, mbuur kàkwenà un'sɛŋ ŋakwo.
Apan kàkäl anà mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy wàŋàtoo làpaan ikɔb ande Yɛsu Barabas.
Abun, Pilatu kàfuul iköŋ a baar bàkwe pa naa: « Nà bɛ làkwen naa mɛ alàwɛɛy awà, Yɛsu Barabas, lɛɛ Yɛsu bàfàbel Klistɔ? »
Ntɔn nde kàkyer ayöbà naa ba Yɛsu bun'pɛɛl awà ntɔn un'köl aba.
Umpal kàkäl Pilatu mutɛɛnà ndaa u làbay a nsaŋ, un'kyay ande kun'tööm ndaa naa: « Twon an'bilà u ndaa a mbuur a balàbal wun, ntɔn ŋàbawà mɛ an'man mpay mbɔɔn u ndwɛy ntɔn nde. »
Andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ bàsiinà iköŋ a baar a ngwal naa ba bàlɔ̈m Barabas anà bàdwä Yɛsu.
Kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kàfafuul naa: « Nà mɛ in'wɛy uboo a ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l? » – Ba naa: « Barabas! »
Pilatu kafuul naa: « Abun, ininà mɛ in'yàkyer anà Yɛsu bàfàbel Klistɔ? » Ba banswà bàfuur naa: « Wɛy bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! »
Pilatu kafuul naa: « Abun, ube nà nde kàkyer? » Wɛɛ ba bàsöönà musà in'kwɛŋ: « Wɛy bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! »

Umpal kàmɛn Pilatu naa nde undiir asin afàkyer watɛy, wɛɛ lingyoomà làmusöönà, nde kàwɛl an'dà, kàywɛb mpin u mii a un'sɛŋ, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ, mɛ un'baranki watɛy unsà an'kil a mbuur wà. Ayin nsaŋ abɛ ŋakwo! »
Wɛɛ un'sɛŋ wanswà kàfuur naa: « Wɛy an'kil ande màbü udu abi anà udu a baan abi! »
Apan, Pilatu katsuuŋ awà Barabas. Wɛɛ akà Yɛsu, ungö akun'kam an'füm, nde kapɛ awà ntɔn bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Aŋità bàmusɛɛ Yɛsu
Aŋità a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r bàsyen Yɛsu u làpaŋ a Pilatu, un'lwaaŋ a aŋità wanswà waa kun'diŋà.
Ba bun'sɔɔl ipfɛy, waa bun'bwää kàzak a tsöö.
Ungö apan ba bun'tööŋ mpà a ibyääl yà nsyeenà, waa bun'bwää kà un'tswe, anà bun'si ibwiy u kɔɔ ande libaal. Ungö, ba bàbü an'köm, waa bun'sɛɛ naa: « Mfum a Ayudà, mbɔr angye! »
Ba bun'tsüülà an'tɛ, bàwɛlà ibwiy, waa bun'kämà kya kun'tswe.
Ungö amukun'sɛɛ, ba bun'sɔɔl kàzak, waa bàfun'bwää ipfɛy ande, waa bun'syen ntɔn bàkun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Mbɛɛr a Yɛsu u kulunsi
Umpal bàkäl ba mutoo u bul, ba bàbweey anà un'nsi Sirɛn mwɛy ikɔb ande Simɔn. Aŋità bun'siinà a ngwal musyen kulunsi a Yɛsu.
Mpal bàtöl ba kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel naa Ngɔlɔngɔta, iswaŋà naa « Ikal a Bɔl a Un'tswe. »
Akun, ba bun'nüü vin aŋàtüüb a undiir a nyän. Mpal kàkyee nde la, laa kàtön nde munwà la.
Mpal bàmay ba mukun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi, ba bàtɔɔm löb ntɔn mukab ipfɛy ande.
Ungö, ba bàkäl aŋàbwaay paa mukun'lerà.
Udu a un'tswe ande, ba bàsön isin a ndaa a nkweel ande: « Mbuur wà wà Yɛsu, mfum a Ayudà. »
Apan, baar abe bɔ̈ɔ̈l babɛɛrà sye u kulunsi mbwo mwɛy anà nde, umwɛy u kɔɔ a ibaal, wumwɛy u kɔɔ a ikaar.
Alyaaŋ a mbwo bàkyer un'bɛyà, bàmunii un'tswe,
waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Ngye mbuur afàbwiy ndwà a Nzam anà afàtɔŋ ya unsà ilä itär, tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye, ngye ŋakwo, isàkal naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, tɔlà u kulunsi! »
Mbwo mwɛy sye, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà andweer bàkyer un'sɛɛ, waa bàtɛɛnà naa:
« Nde kàtsü baar bumwɛy mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ nde ukwe anki mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ŋakwo! Nde wà Mfum a Isàlɛl, wɛy nde utɔlà apanà u kulunsi, waa bi iyàsà làkwikilà amu nde.
Nde kàsi làkwikilà akà Nzam, wɛy Nzam kun'tsuuŋ apanà, isàkal naa nde akyun'kwen. Ntɔn nde kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ in'wà Mwan a Nzam." »
Itàkal baar abe akwà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi mbwo mwɛy anà nde, bàkyer un'too sye.
Nkweel a Yɛsu
Sɛmà midi, làpib làkyer abwà u mɛɛn manswà tii u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi.
Ntsü a taaŋ làtär ungö a midi, Yɛsu kàsi in'kwɛŋ a ngwal: « Ɛli, Ɛli, lema sabaktani » iswaŋà naa « Nzam amɛ, Nzam amɛ, ntɔn nkye aman'piy ngye? »
Amwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl pa, mpal bun'wem ba, ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Le, nde kan'bel Ɛli! »
Umwɛy uboo a ba kàkaamà ntiin, kàkàwal für làmwɛy, kànwɛmà la uboo a man a nyän, laa kàsi nde la u kite, waa kun'pɛ ntɔn munwà.
Bumwɛy bàtɛn naa: « Tàmbar bi itàler nkye Ɛli akyàyà mukun'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈! »
Apan Yɛsu kàfàkuub un'kwɛŋ a ngwal, waa kàkü.
Taaŋ nsil alan, u ndwà a Nzam, rido a idwà làkyer akaamà uboboo fà du tii ngyɛl. Mɛɛn màkyer atɛɛr, nkɔŋ yàkyer abàbaarà,
an'dii màkyer adubà, ndür a baar inkyɛɛl mbɔɔn bàkü yàkyer awiyà:
bàtoo ba kan'dii, ungö a uwiyà, waa bàbilà uboo a bul in'kyɛɛl, waa bàmɛnà akà baar mbɔɔn.
Mpal bàmɛn ba ntɛɛr a mɛɛn anà ndaa yàbü, kaptɛn anà aŋità bàkäl anà nde museyà Yɛsu, bàmɛn bɔɔmà a kölàköl, waa bàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa, mbuur awà kàkäl Mwan a Nzam! »
Paa bàkäl anà akaar mbɔɔn bàleerà ukwɛl. Ba bàyilabà Yɛsu sɛmà Ngalilɛ ntɔn muyun'syääl.
Uboo a ba, bàkäl Màlye un'si Magàdala, Màlye ngwän a Zyak anà Yɔsɛfi, anà un'kyay a Zebeday.
Yɛsu bàmusà kà an'dii
Mpal làbü sisye, aŋun'naaŋ mwɛy un'nsi Arimatɛ, ikɔb ande Yɔsefi, awà kàbulà sye un'lɔŋki a Yɛsu, waa kàyàkɔlà.
Mbuur awà kàkàman Pilatu, waa kàlɔ̈ɔ̈m ndom a Yɛsu. Apan Pilatu kàswɛŋ naa bun'pɛ ayà.
Yɔsɛfi kàwɛl ya, kàläl ya ipfɛy a pɛɛl kyàkün,
waa kàkàtɔl ya uboo a an'dii akün amà bun'fuun u nkɔŋ. Ungö, nde kàbuum nkɔŋ ntɔn mudübà munàmbwo a an'dii. Waa kàkyen.
Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà anà Màlye wumwɛy bàkäl paa, bàŋàbwaay u sim a an'dii.
Nseey a an'dii
Taaŋtyà, ilä kyàlääb ngyööŋ a un'kyɔm a saba, amfum a angaŋ anà Amfarisi bàkyen mbwo mwɛy akà Pilatu,
waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Nkum, bi kan'yɔbà naa ŋaloor wà, mpal kàkäl nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, kàtɛɛnà naa: "Ungö a ilä itär, mɛ in'sàkyer awiyà."

Abun, swaŋ baar musey an'dii ande tii kà ilä kyàtär, uman naa alɔŋki ande bàyàyib ndür ande anà bàyàtɛn a un'sɛŋ naa: "Nde kàkyàwiyà uboo a akü." Apan loor ande làsàsöön làtàtwɛb. »
Pilatu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làwɛl aŋità abà. Làkyen kàlasey an'dii asànaa làkwen bɛ. »
Abun, bàkyen ba, ba bàbäm nkɔŋ yàkäl u munàmbwo a deŋdeŋ, waa bàsàsà aseey.
